title: centaurea drabifolia subsp. floccosa
intro: Centaurea drabifolia subsp. floccosa, commonly known as the woolly knapweed, is a perennial plant belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and combating infections, making it beneficial for health. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea drabifolia subsp. floccosa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Furthermore, the plant's bioactive constituents have been shown to have potential health benefits, including reducing oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and modulating the immune system.
